Name: (CP) Vanilla Tweaks in SVE (Compatibility Patch)
Author: SeaSea50
Description:
[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/ZxMrNps/mod-details-1.png[/img]

This is a retexture for Stardew Valley Expanded's Tilesheets, certain items and decorations to match the Vanilla Tweaks artstyle!

There are three versions: The main file including the whole Vanilla Tweaks retexture, the optional file version that only retextures the crop tilesheets and the optional file version that only retextures the items (Download ONLY one version).

I recommend using MarsCBG's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24669]Vanilla Tweaks Style SVE Seeds [/url]﻿to get matching SVE seedbag sprites!

Let me know if there's any bugs!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/JtMTbjw/installation.png<img src=[/img]

This is a Content Patcher mod so it goes in your mods folder to work. Here's a step by step process:

 [list=1]
[*]Make sure you have downloaded the requirements


[*]Download and unzip this mod and then drop into your mods folder


[*]You're all done!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/y0bTYfR/credits.png[/img]
[/list]
Original assets goes to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mrtaiyou/about-me?gameId=1303]Taiyo [/url]﻿and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/AirynS/about-me]Airyn[/url]﻿
I can't thank [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/92060238]mrtaiyou[/url]﻿ enough for giving me permission to create and release this mod! Checkout out the main mods:

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21284]Vanilla Tweaks - Farming Edition[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21437]Vanilla Tweaks - Producer Edition[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21436]Vanilla Tweaks - Interface Edition[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21435]Vanilla Tweaks - Warrior Edition[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21351]Vanilla Tweaks - Caves Edition[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21433]Vanilla Tweaks - Aquarium Edition[/url]﻿


Can't forget to thank ConcernedApe for making Stardew Valley :)[/center]
